--- page 6 ---
Connected.
Contacts.
Through voice-activated Ford SYNC,®1,2 Fiesta easily connects to your phone.
Once paired, the system recognizes your phone and downloads your contacts
to support voice calling. Simply touch a button on the leather-wrapped steering
wheel1 and say things like “Call: home” or “Call: Caleb.” SYNC also offers
911 Assist,® and with a SYNC Services account you get business searches,
turn-by-turn driving directions, local movie times and more. Activate SYNC can display incoming text
messages or read them out loud.4
and personalize yours at ford.com/sync. SYNC. Say the word.
Favorites.
SYNC also allows voice-activated control of your tunes via phone, MP3,
USB or iPod.® Ask for your favorite artist or playlist and SYNC responds.
SYNC AppLink™3 lets smartphone users control Pandora®, iHeartRadio®,
Stitcher Smart Radio™, Orangatame OpenBeak and other apps by voice too.
All this, in addition to a 6-month trial subscription to over 130 channels of
unique content from SiriusXM Satellite Radio.1
Your information is always displayed
in an easy-to-read format.
1 Available feature. 2Driving while distracted can result in loss of vehicle control. Only use mobile phones and other devices, even with voice commands,
when it is safe to do so. Not all features are compatible with all phones. SYNC Services varies by trim level and model year and may require a subscription.
Traffic alerts and turn-by-turn directions available in select markets. Message and data rates may apply. 3SYNC AppLink is available on select models 2013 FIESTA
and compatible with select smartphone platforms. Commands may vary by phone and AppLink software. 4Not applicable to all phones. ford.com
